combo_label: At the Cinema × Windmills & Watermills × Shakespeare

entries.clue: Short blade a haunted Scot seems to see before him
Sloping walkway you shuffle along, trampling toes, to reach mid-row
Bankside playhouse of 1599, round and open to the sky
Carrying surplus water off low marshland, the whole point of a Broads mill
Torch-carrying attendant who guides latecomers to their row
Verse of fourteen lines, often closing on a rhymed pair
Curved paddle that lifts marsh water up and over into the dyke
Whirring machine that throws the image out through a little rear window
Archaic word for before, common in his verse because it costs one syllable, not two
Elbow territory disputed with the stranger sitting beside you
Lovestruck Montague heir who weds in secret and dies in a tomb
Plush tip-up perch you claim with a draped coat
Melancholy Danish prince who dithers over avenging his father
Corn carted in for grinding, proverbially useful to the mill
